svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: sA: 32 × 128 fp16 = 8192 bytes, drawn 128 bytes per line (one box = 4 bytes = one bank)
Row r starts at byte 256·r. 256 B = 64 words = two full laps of the 32 banks,
so every row of sA starts at bank 0, and column c of every row sits in the same bank.
